text:
I'm sorry to hear your plant arrived damaged—that's frustrating. I can help you with this right away.

To process a **Damaged on Arrival (DOA) claim**, please reply with:
1. **Your order number** (looks like `LF-` plus six digits)
2. **Two photos**: one of the snapped stem and one of the box it arrived in

Once I have those, I'll arrange a free replacement on the next plant shipping day or process a refund. You have **48 hours from delivery** to report, so please send photos as soon as you can.
